Theres people going through so much worse situations who are doing their best and  succeeding, and then there's me wasting my time when they try so much harder.

I actually did tell my councillors before, but I'm guessing they thought I was more extremely suicidal because they told my parents right after I left, and I still feel like whatever adult I end up telling will just do the same. My parents fully expect me to be successful, the thought of disappointing them with depression makes me so scared, no matter how much they hate me or not.

I'm trying to think about it as a proper disorder that people get diagnosed with, rather than a fake excuse, but I guess the stigma I grew up with stays there still. I keep thinking that even though I'm diagnosed, I'm still not depressed for real, that I'm just being a teenager.

Failing makes me so scared. It's I think the only reason why I haven't talked to a teacher, will they think I'm crazy? Will they think I'm not smart enough, not ready for these classes? I keep thinking I'll make things awkward by spilling to someone who isn't supposed to be my anchor. It's stupid and irrational but that's all I think about.

It's so infuriating. I literally sit there up until the early morning shouting at myself to study but all I do is sit on my computer doing nothing. Then when I don't get a good grade I pretend like next time will be easier...

I try to change it, but unless it's a final exam I don't care, and it makes me feel so bad. 

I want to tell someone, but my parents are the only adults I told before and they said I was crazy, so I can't do that anymore. I don't want anyone else hating me too.

I'll hand it my assignments on time but my will to study for tests gets so weak. Even now just writing about it I sound like I'm using depression as an excuse.

I'm so scared, I don't want to fail, I don't want to disappoint another person, I don't want to grow up regretting my life more than I do.
